Class Gradle

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.gradle.Gradle
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class Gradle extends AnahataToolkit
A toolkit for running Gradle tasks in projects linked to IntelliJ's external-system framework.

The IntelliJ counterpart of the Maven toolkit for Gradle-based projects. It uses only the provider-agnostic external-system API (addressing Gradle by its "GRADLE" system id) so it does not compile-depend on the Gradle plugin's own classes; the running IDE routes execution to the bundled Gradle plugin (declared in plugin.xml). Tasks run via ExternalSystemUtil.runTask(ExternalSystemTaskExecutionSettings, String, Project, ProjectSystemId), waiting (bounded) for completion through a TaskCallback. Task console output streams to the IDE's Gradle/Run tool window.

    • runGradleTask

      public String runGradleTask(String projectPath, List<String> tasks, String scriptParameters, Integer timeoutSeconds) throws AgiToolException
      Runs one or more Gradle tasks in a linked Gradle project and waits (bounded) for completion.
      Parameters:
      projectPath - the absolute path of the Gradle project root (the directory holding build.gradle/settings.gradle).
      tasks - the Gradle task names to run (e.g. ["clean","build"]).
      scriptParameters - optional extra command-line parameters (e.g. "--info -x test"), or null.
      timeoutSeconds - optional wait timeout in seconds (default 300); the task keeps running in the IDE if it exceeds the wait.
      Returns:
      a structured summary of the outcome.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if no hosting project can be resolved or the wait is interrupted.

    • resolveProject

      private com.intellij.openapi.project.Project resolveProject(String projectPath) throws AgiToolException

      Returns:
      the hosting IntelliJ project.
